sections.name: HabitsView (part 1)
sections.title: Header with tabs and New Habit button
sections.what: Shows the top of the Habits page: a gamification card, three tabs (Active Habits, Vault, Analytics) with live counts, and a New Habit button that opens the create form. The Vault tab groups paused and archived habits together.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the user switch between current habits, stored-away habits and statistics without leaving the page.
sections.watch_out: Paused and archived habits share one Vault list, so this page does not show which of the two a habit is.

sections.name: HabitsView (part 2)
sections.title: Tab content and create form
sections.what: Shows the content for the selected tab: the analytics dashboard, a grid of paused or archived habits with an empty-state message, or a grid of active habits with its own empty-state message. The create form sits at the bottom and stays hidden until New Habit is clicked.
sections.why: Likely reason: only one list is shown at a time, which keeps the page uncluttered.
sections.watch_out: This page opens the form only for new habits, so editing an existing habit from here is not possible in this code.
